INF = float('inf')

def merge_sort(a, b, p, r):
    if p < r:
        q = (p + r) // 2
        merge_sort(a, b, p, q)
        merge_sort(a, b, q + 1, r)
        merge(a, b, p, q, r)

def merge(a, b, p, q, r):
    n1 = q - p + 1
    n2 = r - q
    L = [0] * (n1 + 1)
    R = [0] * (n2 + 1)
    L1 = [0] * (n1 + 1)
    R1 = [0] * (n2 + 1)

    for i in range(n1):
        L[i] = a[p + i]
        L1[i] = b[p + i]
    for i in range(n2):
        R[i] = a[q + 1 + i]
        R1[i] = b[q + 1 + i]
    L[n1] = R[n2] = INF
    L1[n1] = R1[n2] = INF

    i = j = 0
    for k in range(p, r + 1):
        if L[i] <= R[j]:
            a[k] = L[i]
            b[k] = L1[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            a[k] = R[j]
            b[k] = R1[j]

def sieve(n):
    a = [1] * (n + 1)
    a[0] = a[1] = 0
    for i in range(2, int(math.sqrt(n)) + 1):
        if a[i] == 1:
            for j in range(i * i, n + 1, i):
                a[j] = 0
    return a

def sum_digits(a):
    su = 0
    while a > 0:
        su += a % 10
        a //= 10
    return su

def is_prime(n):
    if n == 1:
        return True
    if n < 2:
        return False
    for i in range(2, int(math.sqrt(n)) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
    return True

def is_vowel(c):
    return c in "aeiouy"

def gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        t = b
        b = a % b
        a = t
    return a

def gd(a, b):
    m = gcd(a, b)
    q = []
    i = 1
    while i * i <= m:
        if m % i == 0:
            q.append(i)
            if i != m // i:
                q.append(m // i)
        i += 1
    return q

def sum_n(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

def divisors(n, m):
    if n - (m + (m * m)) >= 0:
        return m
    for i in range(int(math.sqrt(m)), 0, -1):
        if m % i == 0 and n - (m + (m * i)) >= 0:
            return i
    return 1

def cal(val, k, t):
    res = val
    p = 1
    while val // (k ** p) > 0:
        res += val // (k ** p)
        p += 1
    return res >= t

def last_occurrence_int(a, n, v):
    start, end, ans = 0, n - 1, -1
    while start <= end:
        mid = start + ((end - start) // 2)
        if a[mid] >= v:
            ans = mid
            end = mid - 1
        else:
            start = mid + 1
    return ans

def last_occurrence_long(a, n, v):
    sta, end = 0, n - 1
    while sta <= end:
        mid = sta + ((end - sta) // 2)
        if a[mid] == v:
            return True
        elif a[mid] > v:
            end = mid - 1
        else:
            sta = mid + 1
    return False

class Scanner:
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.lines = []
        for line in sys.stdin:
            self.lines.append(line.strip())
        self.index = 0
    
    def next(self):
        while self.index < len(self.lines):
            tokens = self.lines[self.index].split()
            if tokens:
                token = tokens.pop(0)
                if not self.lines[self.index]:
                    self.index += 1
                return token
            self.index += 1
        return None
    
    def nextDouble(self):
        return float(self.next())
    
    def nextInt(self):
        return int(self.next())
    
    def nextLong(self):
        return int(self.next())
    
    def nextLine(self):
        if self.index < len(self.lines):
            line = self.lines[self.index]
            self.index += 1
            return line
        return None

class Pair:

def main():
    scanner = Scanner(sys.stdin)
    
    n = scanner.nextInt()
    B = scanner.nextInt()
    a = []
    for i in range(n):
        a.append(scanner.nextInt())

    odd = 0

        if (a[i] & 1) == 0:
            even += 1

        if even == odd:
            sol.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))
    
    sol.sort()

        if sol[i] <= B:
            ans += 1
            B -= sol[i]
        else:
